title: Basketball roundup: North boys edge Mooreville; South girls win

paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc’s boys basketball team edged Mooreville 55–54 on the road Thursday, November 5. The Vikings’ one-point win is listed as a nonconference final in the MaxPreps game record.
North Pontotoc’s girls also played at Mooreville, falling 59–40. MaxPreps lists that game as a final, giving the Troopers the girls victory while the Vikings won the boys matchup.
South Pontotoc’s girls won 69–25 at Byhalia the same night, according to their final game record.
